*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: {{workspace:task/jamal-vllm-34752-20260816}}/knowledge/runbooks/kv-cache-dtype-rollout.md
+# KV-cache dtype rollout
+
+Owner: Serving Infrastructure
+
+## Validated precedence
+
+Resolve KV-cache dtype before backend selection:
+
+1. If a ModelOpt checkpoint contains a supported `kv_cache_quant_algo`, it is
+   authoritative. An omitted `--kv-cache-dtype`, explicit `auto`, or an
+   equivalent explicit dtype adopts that value.
+2. A conflicting explicit dtype is rejected during configuration. The error
+   identifies the requested and checkpoint dtypes and tells the operator to
+   remove the flag, use `auto`, or use the checkpoint dtype.
+3. Unsupported checkpoint metadata is rejected during configuration; it must
+   never silently fall back to the model dtype.
+4. Without checkpoint KV metadata, omitted/`auto` follows the model dtype and
+   an explicit supported dtype is used as requested.
+
+`fp8` and `fp8_e4m3` are equivalent for ModelOpt metadata. Current supported
+checkpoint algorithms are `fp8` and `nvfp4`.
+
+## Compatibility matrix
+
+| Checkpoint metadata | Requested dtype | Resolution | Deployment disposition |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| `fp8` | omitted, `auto`, `fp8`, `fp8_e4m3` | `fp8_e4m3` | Canary on validated SM89+ pool |
+| `fp8` | any conflicting dtype | configuration error | Do not deploy; use checkpoint-compatible config |
+| `nvfp4` | omitted, `auto`, `nvfp4` | `nvfp4` | Canary only on validated SM100 path |
+| `nvfp4` | any conflicting dtype | configuration error | Do not deploy |
+| absent | omitted or `auto` | model dtype | Existing compatibility applies |
+| absent | explicit supported dtype | explicit dtype | Validate backend and hardware first |
+| unknown/malformed | any | configuration error | Fix or replace checkpoint metadata |
+
+Hardware gates: FP8 KV cache is validated for H100/SM90 and B200/GB200-class
+SM100+ pools. A100/SM80 and earlier pools must not receive this checkpoint-led
+FP8 rollout until their selected backend has separate validation. NVFP4 is
+restricted to the validated SM100 execution path. These gates are deployment
+policy in addition to vLLM's own backend checks.
+
+## Deployment precheck
+
+- Pin the model/checkpoint digest, vLLM build, attention backend, GPU SKU,
+  compute capability, driver hash, and resolved KV-cache dtype in the change
+  record.
+- Inspect checkpoint `quantization_config`, including nested `quantization`,
+  `kv_cache_scheme`, and `kv_cache_quant_algo`. Run configuration creation on
+  CPU and record the resolved dtype or actionable rejection.
+- Reject pools outside the compatibility matrix. Confirm CI is green, nodes
+  are ready, the fallback profile is set, and capacity/cache-memory headroom is
+  at least 15%.
+- Run GPU smoke and quality/perplexity comparison on the exact checkpoint,
+  backend, and hardware tuple. Include prefix-cache, eager/graph, and representative
+  context-length coverage.
+- Record baseline p95/p99 latency, request errors, GPU OOMs, token throughput,
+  cache hit/eviction rates, and output-quality metrics.
+
+## Canary
+
+Use the published standard stages, extending holds for quantization risk:
+
+1. 1% for 30–60 minutes.
+2. 5% for 60 minutes.
+3. 25% for two hours.
+4. 100% only after every gate remains healthy.
+
+Maintain at least 15% cache-memory headroom. Automatically roll back any
+guardrail breach sustained for 10 minutes or an error spike above 2x baseline
+for 5 minutes. Also stop immediately for GPU OOMs, backend dtype errors,
+material quality regression, or unexpected resolved-dtype drift.
+
+## Rollback
+
+Keep the previous checkpoint plus runtime/profile immutable and routable.
+Rollback means atomically restoring that complete tuple, not changing only the
+CLI flag. Drain new admissions from the canary, route to the fallback profile,
+verify error/latency recovery, and invalidate incompatible warmed KV caches.
+Preserve the failed tuple, resolver error, stage timestamps, metrics, and model
+outputs for incident review. Do not retry on an older GPU family by overriding
+checkpoint metadata.
+
+## Evidence
+
+- Issue snapshot and expected cases: document
+  `gh_36ec2f8e340c6c23165329ce2a61a18a`,
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/github_public/vllm-project/vllm/issues/34752.json`.
+- Fail-closed conflict validation: document
+  `gh_103916df5e5ca5074ec889e40bdeeb76`,
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/github_public/vllm-project/vllm/pulls/35762.json`.
+- GPU architecture behavior: document
+  `gh_109a136791ea446f5f5401e4c0d8df48`,
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/github_public/vllm-project/vllm/pulls/43914.json`.
+- Redwood rollout stages, 15% headroom, and rollback thresholds: document
+  `dsid_79aba7601ab24ca699516975ecd5dd86`,
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/performance-standards/economizer-serving-recommendations-standard.json`.
+- Pinned source commit `272abd5f486967f1fb9db7ca7504f8c34235ef50`:
+  document `infra_b76d8f7fbd48abadca12635dc03244d0`,
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/slack/eng-runtime/infra-v1-slack-033.json`.
*** End Patch
